facts.fact: 她独自站在隆冬的湖心，四周是密林。
facts.anchor: She was alone in the heart of winter, standing in the middle of a frozen lake surrounded by dense forests.

facts.fact: 一阵徒劳感几乎压碎她的肺，她仍继续向前。
facts.anchor: A sense of futility began to crush her lungs, yet she pressed forward

facts.fact: 他终于听见了，终于转过身来。
facts.anchor: At last, he heard. At last, he turned to her.

facts.fact: 昏迷之后的两天里，她在清醒与昏睡之间浮沉。
facts.anchor: She drifted in and out of consciousness over the next two days

facts.fact: 她看见他无名指上的婚戒，胸口的忐忑松了下来。
facts.anchor: at the sight of the wedding band on his ring finger

facts.fact: 阿拉里克说若她想解除婚约，他会尽力配合。
facts.anchor: Should you wish to seek an annulment, I will cooperate to the best of my ability

facts.fact: 塔拉辛回答说她要一场真正像样的蜜月。
阿拉里克声音沙哑地连说我爱你。
facts.anchor: I love you, I love you, I love you,” he said hoarsely
